messages:
maya: Filing a tiny follow-up PR to the model catalog: clarify tokenization differences in Aurora-Lite-4B model card and adjust the 'limits' table. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4387. Need bench numbers + a quick SDK snippet to show token counting and a streaming stop-pattern. Ping @alex @sam.

alex: thanks — quick note: our previous card used raw character counts which confused some folks. please add a 'tokenization' row that states the tokenizer is BPE v2 and give an example 'Hello world' -> 3 tokens.

sam: i re-ran the microbench to check tokenization effects. attaching results: https://internal.storage/benches/aurora-lite-tokenization-2026-03-22.csv. TL;DR: when you include a leading space in prompts token count can increase by 1-2 tokens on short prompts, which changes cost calc. p50 throughput (2k seq) = 24 tok/s, p95 = 8 tok/s.

claire: small editorial: in the limits table we should show two rows: "max_sequence (GPU)" and "max_sequence (quant-cpu fallback)" with values 8192 and 4096 respectively. avoids misleading customers.

maya: good call. i'll update the table. also @alex can you confirm whether we should recommend trimming leading/trailing spaces in sample prompts?

alex: yes recommend trimming. add a short note: "Avoid unnecessary leading/trailing whitespace — tokenizer may add extra tokens." Also link to tokenization guide: https://go.redwood/tokenizer-guide

maya: adding the SDK snippet for token counting + streaming example to the PR. snippet below, please sanity-check for SDK v3 compatibility.

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# helper: count tokens before send
text = "Translate this to French: Hello world"
meta = client.tokenize(text)
print(f"tokens={meta.token_count}")

# streaming generation with explicit stop and safe-reconnect
try:
    with client.stream_generate('aurora-lite-4b', prompt=text, max_tokens=200, stop=["\n\n"]) as s:
        for chunk in s:
            print(chunk.text, end='')
except ConnectionError:
    # resume using last cursor token if available
    if 'last_cursor' in locals():
        with client.stream_generate('aurora-lite-4b', prompt=text, resume_from=last_cursor) as s:
            for chunk in s:
                print(chunk.text, end='')
    else:
        raise
```

sam: snippet looks fine. small nit: client.tokenize returns token_count as int in v3, but in v4 it's token_count_str — but the PR targets docs for SDK v3 users. maybe add a parenthetical: (SDK v4: use meta['token_count_str']).

maya: added that parenthetical. i also inserted a one-line note under benchmarks: "Benchmarks measured with whitespace-trimmed prompts unless otherwise noted."

doc-bot: Docs checklist passed: lint OK, samples formatted, internal link check failed (tokenizer-guide link is a redirect).

alex: thanks doc-bot. maya — for the link redirect, replace go.redwood/tokenizer-guide with the canonical /docs/tokenization/v2 in the PR. i'll run a final review for wording today.

maya: updated link and pushed. i'll wait for alex to approve then merge. (reacts :rocket:)
